text:
Priya: customer ACCT-9932 reports ~800k token charge overnight from their nightly-rerank job. trial promo NEWTRIAL50 was supposed to offset charges but balance dropped to 0 :confused:

Tom: did they use their account key or a service key in the worker?

Priya: they set ACCOUNT_KEY in env for the worker. logs below show webhook ack lag and scheduler requeue

```
2026-03-18T00:11:12Z worker[rerank]: POST /v1/rerank 200 id=job-43b2 header-X-Job-Guid=job-43b2
2026-03-18T00:11:45Z scheduler: callback ack timeout for id=job-43b2, reenqueue
2026-03-18T00:12:01Z worker[rerank]: POST /v1/rerank 200 id=job-43b2 attempts=2 header-X-Job-Guid=job-43b2
```

Priya: looks like scheduler requeued when webhook ack exceeded callback timeout, then original worker still finished and called /v1/rerank again — two billed requests for same job

Rachel: can you paste the exact request ids from billing?

Priya: billing events show two distinct request_ids but same job_guid header = job-43b2. snippet: 

```
billing_event: acct=ACCT-9932 request_id=req-9a8f timestamp=2026-03-18T00:11:12Z job_guid=job-43b2 amount_tokens=412300 promo=NEWTRIAL50_applied
billing_event: acct=ACCT-9932 request_id=req-9a8f-dup timestamp=2026-03-18T00:12:01Z job_guid=job-43b2 amount_tokens=389700 promo=NOT_APPLIED
```

Dave: infra-bot created incident RERANK-560 assigned to @Tom and @Rachel

infra-bot: Incident RERANK-560 created for ACCT-9932 unexpected billing spike  assigned to Tom, Rachel

Tom: likely root causes: webhook ack timeout + scheduler requeue, no idempotency enforcement on rerank endpoint, billing applies promo at auth/enqueue time but doesn't collapse duplicate charges

Rachel: proposed actions:
- issue manual credit for the duplicate charge to restore trial balance
- add X-Job-Guid idempotency enforcement at /v1/rerank (server-side dedupe)
- implement billing dedupe window: collapse charges sharing job_guid within 5m
- review scheduler lease/ack timings for nightly-rerank queue

Priya: customer wants repro steps and an ATA (ack timeline). minimal repro supplied:

```
# simulate flaky webhook ack and requeue
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer acct-9932-key' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Job-Guid: job-43b2' \n  -d '{"queries":["q1"], "model":"re-rank-16"}'
# run worker with lease=1s and make callback handler sleep 3s to force scheduler to mark it timed out and reenqueue
```

Tom: to reproduce locally, run the scheduler with short lease and a worker that intentionally sleeps past lease. ensure the worker does not exit after requeue to mimic duplicate in-flight execution

Rachel: short-term patch we can deploy today:
- billing-side: dedupe charges that share X-Job-Guid within 5m and respect promo coverage on the first seen request
- rerank service: if request has X-Job-Guid and we have a processed marker, return 200 immediately and avoid double-execution

Dave: long-term: use Redis SETNX lock per job_guid with TTL > max lease to prevent overlapping execution; require background jobs to send X-Job-Guid by default; surface requeue vs processed counts in Console so customers can see retries; and audit rerank/rerank-batch queues for similar patterns

billing-team: please standby for CSV from Priya; we'll need invoice ids to issue manual credit.

Tom: I'll open a small PR to add the idempotency check and coordinate a canary deploy to staging tonight. Rachel can follow up on billing dedupe logic.

Priya: customer accepted a temporary credit while we investigate. uploading logs + billing CSV to the incident now.

infra-bot: follow-ups created: RERANK-561 (billing dedupe), RERANK-562 (scheduler lease audit), RERANK-563 (idempotency hotfix).

Priya: closing this support thread (customer notified). keeping incident RERANK-560 open for engineering work and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
